title.english: The Daily Life of a Part-time Torturer
title.native: 拷問バイトくんの日常

synonyms: ชีวิตประจำวันของพนักงานพาร์ตไทม์รับจ้างทรมาน

node.description:
__Height:__ 186 cm

He's the longest-serving part-time worker at Spirytus, having been with the company since it was founded. He's 29 years old. As [Cero's](https://anilist.co/character/373035/Cero) senior, he strictly teaches his juniors how to do their jobs. He uses all kinds of means and tools, but his favorite tool is the whip. His favorite hobby is reading. His favorite food is Sushi and he dislikes oysters.

__Height:__ 178 cm

Part-time worker at Spirytus. Skilled and sociable. He's good at any job and has moved from one part-time job to another, but he seems to find his job of "torture" rewarding. His favorite tool is the "hammer." He doesn't have hobbies, and insteads gambles to kill time. His favorite food is katsudon and he dislikes broccoli.

__Height:__ 201 cm

Spirytus's new part-timer. He tried to avoid interacting with people as much as possible, but started this part-time job to learn about society. For a certain reason, he always hides his face. His favorite tool is the “watering can.” His hobby is solo camping. He enjoys eating hamburg steak and dislikes liver.

__Height:__ 155 cm

Spirytus's new part-timer. A novelist with boundless curiosity. Petite with an adorable face, but when he gets absorbed in his work, he sometimes reveals an unexpected side. His favorite tool is the “Cat's Claw.” His hobby is playing FPS games. He enjoys chocolate and he dislikes dandan noodles.

__Height:__ 181 cm

He's the talented president of Spirytus, the industry's top white-collar company. Before founding his company, he and [Shiu](https://anilist.co/character/373036/Shiu) worked as torturers. He cross-dresses because it's his "destiny" to do so due to his sheer beauty. His hobby is driving. He enjoys eating horse sashimi and dislikes onions.

__Height:__ 178 cm

A Spirytus employee. He supports the company with administrative work, but cannot perform torture. Was taken in by [Hela](https://anilist.co/character/0373295/Hela) as a child and has been in love with him ever since. He doesn't get along with [Cero](https://anilist.co/character/373035/Cero). Photography is his personal hobby. His favorite food is omelette rice and he dislikes celery.

__Height:__ 115cm

[Shiu's](https://anilist.co/character/373036/Shiu) beloved daughter. The older twin sister, responsible. Attends elementary school. Loves the color black because it's the color of her beloved Papa and [Nero](https://anilist.co/character/382480/Nero). She like strawberries and dislikes tomatoes.

__Height:__ 115 cm

[Shiu's](https://anilist.co/character/373036/Shiu) beloved daughter. The younger twin sister with a laid-back personality. Attends elementary school. She loves white because it's the color of her beloved dad and [Reu](https://anilist.co/character/382474/Reu). Her favorite food is strawberries and she dislikes carrots.

__Height:__ 184cm

The “doctor” who handles unforeseen incidents during torture. He appears unmotivated, yet holds firm convictions about his work. He shares a complicated history with Spirytus.

__Height:__ 145cm

A "cleaner" contracted to clean the torture chamber. She hides her face with a gas mask while working. She is a big fan of [Mikke's](https://anilist.co/character/373037/Mikke) novels.

__Height:__ 182 cm

[Hugh's](https://anilist.co/character/373038/Hugh) cheerful friend from high school who attends the same university. He cares deeply for his friends and often encourages Hugh when he's feeling down.

__Height:__ 167 cm

The energetic owner of the torture device shop “dolor”. She demands not only practicality but also artistic merit in her torture devices. With a fierce business sense, she'll stop at nothing to make her shop thrive. She enjoys strawberry daifuku and dislikes fatty meat.

__Height:__ 164cm

“The Hitwoman,” [Cero's](https://anilist.co/character/373035/Cero) ex-girlfriend. She met Cero when they were both hosts. A beautiful woman with a straightforward personality, she still has feelings for Cero even after they broke up.

__Height:__ 183cm

A 31-year-old who runs a shadowy network for disposing of criminals and handles post-torture cleanup. He's been involved with Spirytus for a long time, yet remains shrouded in mystery. What matters most to him is “money and trust.”

__Height:__ 158 cm

A nurse working at Izua Hospital. She communicates with anyone other than [Izua](https://anilist.co/character/393208/Izua), whom she trusts, through her stuffed bear Amumu. She's an unusual girl, but she's skilled at her job.

__Height:__ 174cm

[Cero's](https://anilist.co/character/373035/Cero) younger brother. A 17-year-old high school student. He has loved his older brother since childhood and has a brocon complex, but recently Cero has been working all the time and hasn't come home, which makes him feel lonely. He is a member of the library committee and soccer club.
